llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it is a local-only linter/audit for OpenClaw skills that scans skill directories and computes flags/hashes, and its requirements and behavior align with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name and SKILL.md describe a local audit of installed OpenClaw skills. The declared required binaries (bash, find, sha256sum, grep, awk, sort, stat, base64, tr, readlink, mktemp) match the script's operations. No unrelated credentials, config paths, or external services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions invoke bin/claw-lint.sh which enumerates and reads files under configured skill roots (defaults ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills and ~/.openclaw/skills). That is consistent with an audit tool, but note it will read file contents (up to SCAN_MAX_BYTES) to look for patterns and will compute SHA256 hashes for files (up to MAX_BYTES) when --full is used. The script encodes and emits skill names and full directory paths (base64), which reveals local path info in outputs. The SKILL.md says JSON output 'needs python3' but python3 is not listed in the metadata required binaries — a minor mismatch to be aware of.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction/code bundle only). The package contains an audit script and a few empty lib files; nothing is downloaded or installed by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, no external credentials, and no privileged config paths. Its local-file scanning behavior is proportionate to an on-disk audit tool.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent presence or elevated privileges (always:false). It does not modify system or other skills' configuration and does not attempt to execute code from scanned skills; it only reads files and computes hashes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a local-only linter/audit for OpenClaw skills and is coherent with that purpose. Before installing or running it: (1) review bin/claw-lint.sh yourself (it's included) to confirm behavior; (2) be aware it will read files under your skill directories (~/.openclaw/...) and may reveal skill names and full paths (base64-encoded) and SHA256 hashes when run with --full; (3) JSON output requires python3 per SKILL.md, but python3 isn't listed in the metadata — ensure python3 is available if you need JSON; (4) do not run it as root — run as your normal user so it only inspects user-owned skill files. If you need absolute assurance, run the script locally in a controlled environment or inspect it line-by-line before use.
